# AI Workbench — Copilot Instructions

Local AI workbench on ARM Mac (Rancher Desktop + dockerd). Docker Compose services behind an internal bridge network, with Open WebUI and Caddy exposed to the host.

## Architecture

Open WebUI → LiteLLM (gateway) → OpenAI / Anthropic / Azure APIs  
Open WebUI → Chroma (vector store)  
Open WebUI + LiteLLM → Phoenix (OTEL tracing)

- **Open WebUI** — chat frontend (`127.0.0.1:3000` or `chat.localhost`)
- **LiteLLM** — model router/proxy (exposes model aliases like `openai-fast`, `anthropic-strong`; `litellm.localhost`)
- **Chroma** — vector DB for RAG, internal only
- **Phoenix** — observability/tracing via OpenTelemetry (`phoenix.localhost`)
- **Caddy** — reverse proxy / MCP tool front door; also serves the status dashboard at `ai-workbench.localhost`
- **Open Notebook** — optional research UI (`notebook` profile; `notebook.localhost`)
- **SurrealDB** — persistence for Open Notebook (`notebook` profile)

All service config flows from `.env` → `bootstrap.py` → generated files. See [README.md](../README.md) for full details.

## Commands

```bash
make bootstrap        # Generate .env + all config
make validate         # Pre-flight .env validation
make up               # Core + tools (daily driver — no Open Notebook)
make up-notebook      # Core + tools + Open Notebook
make up-core          # Core only (no tools, no notebook)
make up-full          # Everything including debug
make down             # Stop all
make logs             # Tail logs (last 200 lines)
make health           # Run healthcheck.py against all services
make stats            # Tool-usage stats from Phoenix traces
make ps               # List running containers
make config           # Print merged compose config
make clean-generated  # Delete generated config
make open             # Open status dashboard in browser (macOS)
```

## Key conventions

- **`.env` is the single source of truth** for all configuration. Never commit it (gitignored). Compose files use `${VAR}` with **no inline defaults** — every variable must be defined in `.env`.
- **`config/litellm/config.yaml` is generated** — do not hand-edit. Change `.env` then run `make bootstrap` (or `python3 scripts/bootstrap.py --force`).
- **`--force` preserves secrets and user-provided API keys** — all other values (images, ports, etc.) refresh from `.env.example`. To rotate a secret, delete its value in `.env` then re-run `bootstrap.py --force`.
- **`make validate` runs automatically** before `make up` — missing or malformed vars fail fast before Docker starts.
- **LiteLLM is exposed on localhost by default** at `127.0.0.1:4000`; `docker-compose.override.yml` is still available if you want to expose additional internal services like Phoenix.
- Python scripts use `pathlib.Path`; workspace root derived via `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`.
- Python environment: conda env `ai-workbench` (see `.python-version`).
- `ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG=false` in Open WebUI forces env-var-only config on each startup.
- All services have **memory limits** (`deploy.resources.limits.memory`) to reduce memory pressure.
- **Proxy isolation**: `.env` uses `WORKBENCH_NO_PROXY` (not `NO_PROXY`) to avoid collisions with host environment variables. All inter-service Docker traffic bypasses the corporate proxy.

## Generated & gitignored files

These files should never be committed or manually created without `bootstrap.py`:

| File | Generated by | Notes |
|------|-------------|-------|
| `.env` | `bootstrap.py` from `.env.example` | Contains secrets (`__GENERATE__` placeholders replaced with random tokens) |
| `config/litellm/config.yaml` | `bootstrap.py` from `.env` values | Conditional model entries based on which API keys are set |
| `docker-compose.override.yml` | Manual copy from `compose.override.example.yml` | Optional; exposes internal services |

## Common pitfalls

- **Embeddings need OpenAI or Azure** — set `OPENAI_API_KEY` or all three of `AZURE_API_KEY`, `AZURE_API_BASE`, `AZURE_EMBEDDING_MODEL`.
- **`DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL` must match a generated alias** — if set to `anthropic-fast`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` must be present or the alias won't exist in LiteLLM config.
- **Open WebUI persists some settings in its volume** — env var changes may not apply after first boot. Update in the UI or recreate the volume (`docker compose down -v`).
- **LiteLLM should be reachable on `127.0.0.1:4000`** — if local port checks fail, verify the compose stack is running and the host port is free.
- **After any `.env` change**: run `python3 scripts/bootstrap.py --force` then `docker compose restart litellm` (or `make up`).
- **`docker compose down -v` deletes all data** (chat history, traces, vectors). Use plain `make down` to preserve volumes.
- **Inter-service connectivity failing?** Check `WORKBENCH_NO_PROXY` in `.env` — every Compose service hostname must be listed or the corporate proxy will intercept the traffic.
